cells.content:
## What the numbers say

- **Coverage is solved; proof is not.** All 20 requirements are mapped (100%) and source coverage is 100% (3/3), but health score penalises execution freshness at 0 because no case was executed in the last 7 days.
- **Automation skews away from risk.** 32 critical cases exist, 1 is automated. Medium priority is the best covered proportionally (24/34 = 71%), high is 54% (31/57), critical is 3% (1/32).
- **Portfolio is e2e-heavy.** e2e + web account for 103 of 123 cases (84%); api 6, security 5, integration 3, performance 3, mobile 3.
- **Status is unfinished.** 121 cases in draft, 1 active, 1 archived — nothing has been promoted to an approved baseline.
- **Script sync is healthy** at 96% (54 of 56 mappings synced; 2 show case-updated drift).

## Suggested next steps

1. Run TP-2 (V1.1) and a smoke slice of the automated 56 to move execution freshness off zero.
2. Automate 3–5 critical cases from REQ-6 (addresses), REQ-9 (UPI) and REQ-15 (prepaid/COD CTAs) — that is the cheapest lift on both automation % and risk.
3. Review and promote the 121 draft cases into active, or archive the ones no longer relevant.
